section: DRDO - vision, mission, structure, major laboratories and technology clusters
subsections: Technology Development Fund (TDF) - support for industry and start-ups
DRDO leadership - Chairman and Secretary DDR&D

accepted.s: Technology Development Fund (TDF) is a flagship programme of which organisation and is implemented under which initiative?
o: Department of Space under Atmanirbhar Bharat
Ministry of Science and Technology under Digital India
Ministry of Defence under Make in India
accepted.x: TDF is a Ministry of Defence flagship programme executed by DRDO under the Make in India initiative.
accepted.tq: Identify the correct ministry–implementing agency combination.
accepted.sec: Technology Development Fund (TDF) - support for industry and start-ups

accepted.s:
With reference to the Technology Development Fund, consider the following statements:
1. It provides grants to industry, including MSMEs and start-ups.
2. The grant may extend up to ₹50 crore.
3. It is intended to support co-development of emerging technologies.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: TDF supports MSMEs and start-ups through grants of up to ₹50 crore and promotes co-development of emerging technologies with private firms.
accepted.tq: Check whether all statements describe different dimensions of one scheme.
accepted.sec: Technology Development Fund (TDF) - support for industry and start-ups

accepted.s: The new TDF policies are particularly intended to bring private firms into the co-development of which technologies?
accepted.x: The new TDF policies focus on deep-tech and cutting-edge technologies and seek greater participation of private firms in co-development.
accepted.tq: Use the distinctive policy focus to eliminate broad but unrelated sectors.
accepted.sec: Technology Development Fund (TDF) - support for industry and start-ups

accepted.s: Under the policy of free access to DRDO patents, which one of the following correctly describes the technology-transfer record cited for DRDO?
o: More than 132 free transfers covering more than 2,100 systems
More than 50 free transfers covering 2,100 systems
More than 2,100 free transfers covering more than 132 systems
accepted.x: DRDO has completed more than 2,100 free technology transfers to Indian industry, covering more than 132 systems.
accepted.tq: Split the two numerical quantities and match each with its correct unit.
accepted.sec: Technology Development Fund (TDF) - support for industry and start-ups

accepted.s: Which of the following groups consists only of conventional DRDO missiles approved for technology transfer to private industry in August 2026?
accepted.x: The approved conventional-missile group comprises Astra, Rudram, Nag and VSHORADS. Nuclear-capable Agni and K-series missiles remain in state production.
accepted.tq: Separate the approved conventional group from the excluded strategic missiles.
accepted.sec: Technology Development Fund (TDF) - support for industry and start-ups

accepted.s: Which of the following missiles remain in state production rather than being included in the August 2026 transfer of conventional DRDO missiles to private industry?
accepted.x: Nuclear-capable Agni and K-series missiles were excluded from the transfer and remain in state production.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the conventional-missile transfer list from the strategic-missile exception.
accepted.sec: Technology Development Fund (TDF) - support for industry and start-ups

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements regarding DRDO technology transfer is correct?
o: DRDO test facilities are restricted exclusively to government laboratories.
DRDO patents are available to Indian industry only after payment of royalty since 2020.
Industry has received royalty-free access to DRDO patents through technology transfer since 2020.
Technology transfer is limited to foreign companies partnered with DRDO.
accepted.x: Since 2020, Indian industry has received royalty-free access to DRDO patents through technology transfer, and DRDO test facilities are open to the private sector.
accepted.tq: Watch for the reversed royalty and access conditions.
accepted.sec: Technology Development Fund (TDF) - support for industry and start-ups

accepted.s: DFP-2026, relating to the Delegation of Financial Powers to DRDO, was released with the principal objective of:
o: Transferring all DRDO laboratories to the private sector
Creating a separate armed force under DRDO
accepted.x: DFP-2026 was released by the Defence Minister to speed up DRDO projects by delegating appropriate financial powers.
accepted.tq: Match the administrative instrument with its practical function.
accepted.sec: Technology Development Fund (TDF) - support for industry and start-ups

accepted.s: Which of the following is correctly matched with a joint forum associated with India's defence-technology cooperation?
o: Indo-Israel Management Council — administration of state police forces
India-USA Joint Technology Group — management of civil aviation
Indo-Israel Management Council — monetary policy coordination
India-USA Joint Technology Group — defence-technology cooperation
accepted.x: The India-USA Joint Technology Group is one of the joint forums associated with defence-technology cooperation. The Indo-Israel Management Council is another such forum.
accepted.tq: Reject the options that assign defence-technology forums unrelated functions.
accepted.sec: Technology Development Fund (TDF) - support for industry and start-ups

accepted.s: DRDO assisted ISRO in testing which system associated with the Gaganyaan programme?
accepted.x: DRDO helped ISRO test the Gaganyaan crew-escape parachute recovery system.
accepted.tq: Identify the specific mission component rather than the broad programme name.
accepted.sec: Technology Development Fund (TDF) - support for industry and start-ups

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the leadership structure of DRDO:
1. The Secretary, Department of Defence R&D, also serves as Chairman of DRDO.
2. DG (Technology Clusters) and DG (Corporate) constitute Level II.
3. Lab directors and corporate directorates constitute Level III.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements correctly describe the three-level DRDO hierarchy: Secretary DDR&D and Chairman at Level I, the two DGs at Level II, and lab directors and corporate directorates at Level III.
accepted.tq: Check the hierarchy from the top level downward.
accepted.sec: DRDO leadership - Chairman and Secretary DDR&D

accepted.s: Who held the posts of Secretary, Department of Defence R&D and Chairman, DRDO in 2026?
o: The Director-General of Corporate Directorate alone
accepted.x: Dr. Samir V. Kamat had been Chairman of DRDO since 2022 and continued in office in 2026 while holding the post of Secretary DDR&D.
accepted.tq: Link the person with the combined leadership offices and tenure.
accepted.sec: DRDO leadership - Chairman and Secretary DDR&D

accepted.s: Which DRDO facility in Andhra Pradesh is primarily associated with naval weapons research?
o: ADA Aircraft Integration and Flight Testing Complex
accepted.x: NSTL at Visakhapatnam is DRDO's naval weapons laboratory.
accepted.tq: Use the facility's location and functional identity together.

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT associated with NSTL, Visakhapatnam?
o: Final trials of the ULPGM-V3 in air-to-air and air-to-ground modes
Development of light- and heavy-weight torpedoes
accepted.x: ULPGM-V3 final trials were completed at the test range near Kurnool. NSTL is associated with torpedoes, autonomous underwater vehicles and high-power lithium-ion batteries, among other naval systems.
accepted.tq: Find the facility-function mismatch by separating naval research from missile flight trials.

accepted.s: The Multi-Influence Ground Mine and SMART are associated with which DRDO laboratory?
o: The ADA complex in Sri Sathya Sai district
The CBRN Field Training Centre in Delhi
accepted.x: NSTL, Visakhapatnam develops the Multi-Influence Ground Mine and SMART, or Supersonic Missile Assisted Release of Torpedo.
accepted.tq: Match named naval systems with the laboratory responsible for them.

accepted.s: Nagayalanka in Krishna district is associated with which of the following?
o: A CBRN training centre for national agencies
A naval weapons laboratory for underwater batteries
An aircraft integration complex for flight testing
A DRDO missile test range for flight trials of tactical missiles
accepted.x: Nagayalanka is the site of the planned DRDO missile test range in coastal Krishna district, intended for flight trials of tactical missiles and sea-skimming trials.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the planned coastal range from the other AP facilities.

accepted.s: The test range near Kurnool was associated with the completion of final trials of which system?
accepted.x: Final trials of the ULPGM-V3, a UAV-launched precision-guided missile, were completed near Kurnool in air-to-ground and air-to-air modes.
accepted.tq: Match the location with the specific system tested there.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the ADA Aircraft Integration and Flight Testing Complex:
1. It is located in Sri Sathya Sai district.
2. Its groundbreaking took place in 2026.
3. The investment associated with it is ₹15,803 crore.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The ADA Aircraft Integration and Flight Testing Complex in Sri Sathya Sai district had its groundbreaking in 2026 and involves an investment of ₹15,803 crore.
accepted.tq: Combine location, date and numerical-value statements in one factual cluster.

accepted.s: ADC-150, coordinated by NSTL with the Indian Navy, is best described as:
o: India's first indigenous 150-kg air-droppable container for resupplying ships at sea
An autonomous underwater vehicle for mine detection
accepted.x: ADC-150 is India's first indigenous air-droppable container with a 150-kg capacity, developed for resupplying ships at sea and tested with the Navy.
accepted.tq: Decode the system's purpose from its operational use and capacity.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly represents the location of the major DRDO missile complex consisting of DRDL, RCI and ASL?
accepted.x: The DRDO missile complex comprising DRDL, RCI and ASL is located in Hyderabad, Telangana, next door to Andhra Pradesh but not within it.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between AP facilities and the neighbouring Hyderabad missile complex.

accepted.s: The CBRN Field Training Centre established under INMAS in Delhi is intended to train personnel from which organisations?
o: Only the Indian Navy and Coast Guard
accepted.x: The centre was established under INMAS to train personnel of the Ministry of Defence, Ministry of Home Affairs and National Disaster Management Authority in CBRN-related preparedness.
accepted.tq: Match the training centre with its beneficiary organisations.

accepted.s: Which one of the following combinations contains only DRDO-designed systems identified as contributing to defence self-reliance?
o: INS Vikrant, INS Viraat, INS Khanderi and Admiral Gorshkov
Agni, Prithvi, Tejas, Pinaka and Akash
accepted.x: DRDO designed or contributed to systems including Agni, Prithvi, Tejas, Pinaka and Akash, forming part of the foundation of Aatmanirbharta in defence.
accepted.tq: Select the group whose members belong to the same indigenous DRDO-design category.

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT included among the DRDO flagships described as anchoring defence self-reliance?
accepted.x: BrahMos, Akash and Pinaka are listed among DRDO's flagship systems supporting defence self-reliance. Rafale is not included in that DRDO flagship list.
accepted.tq: Find the non-member of the indigenous DRDO flagship group.

accepted.s:
Arrange the following developments in chronological order:
A. Agni-Prime test from a rail launcher
B. Multi-layered BMD and NASM-MR tests
C. Kusha LR-SAM maiden test
D. IADWS test involving laser directed-energy weapons
accepted.x: The sequence is multi-layered BMD and NASM-MR tests in June 2026, the Kusha LR-SAM maiden test in July 2026, and IADWS in August 2025 would actually precede both 2026 events; therefore the correct chronological sequence is D, A, B, C.
accepted.tq: Anchor the sequence using the stated years before comparing the months.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly states the dates or time references associated with the listed DRDO developments?
o: IADWS with laser DEW — August 2025; Agni-Prime from a rail launcher — 24 September 2025
IADWS with laser DEW — June 2026; Agni-Prime from a rail launcher — 24 August 2025
IADWS with laser DEW — July 2026; Agni-Prime from a rail launcher — 24 September 2024
IADWS with laser DEW — August 2026; Agni-Prime from a rail launcher — 24 September 2026
accepted.x: The IADWS test involving laser directed-energy weapons occurred in August 2025, while the Agni-Prime rail-launcher test took place on 24 September 2025.
accepted.tq: Compare the year and date pairs without reversing the two developments.

accepted.s:
Assertion (A): DRDO's missile and aerospace programmes are regarded as a base of Aatmanirbharta in defence.
Reason (R): DRDO has designed or contributed to systems such as Agni, Prithvi, Tejas, Pinaka, Akash, BrahMos, ASAT, AEW&C, Arjun and Varunastra.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
accepted.x: Both statements are true, and the broad range of indigenous systems cited in the Reason explains why DRDO's programmes form a base of defence self-reliance.
accepted.tq: Test whether the supporting list directly explains the stated significance.

accepted.s: Which of the following combinations correctly identifies the Andhra Pradesh locations highlighted in connection with defence infrastructure and manufacturing?
o: NSTL Visakhapatnam, Kurnool test range, Nagayalanka range and ADA complex in Sri Sathya Sai district
DRDL Hyderabad, INMAS Delhi, NSTL Bengaluru and Nagayalanka in Telangana
Kurnool shipyard, Visakhapatnam CBRN centre, Hyderabad ADA complex and Delhi missile range
Nagayalanka spaceport, Kurnool naval base, Visakhapatnam satellite centre and Sri Sathya Sai nuclear plant
accepted.x: The AP defence-infrastructure locations highlighted are NSTL at Visakhapatnam, the Kurnool test range, the planned Nagayalanka range and the ADA complex in Sri Sathya Sai district.
accepted.tq: Match each facility with its correct Andhra Pradesh location and avoid state-boundary traps.
